name: layout-text-flip
title: Layout Text Flip
description: A fixed line of heading text with a rounded badge beside it that holds one word at a time. Every few seconds the word blurs out and a new one drops in, the badge resizing to fit each phrase.
use: A headline must cover several products or benefits without adding more lines or vertical space.
avoid: The word changes on a timer with no pause, and the badge width jumps whenever phrase lengths differ.
a11y: The timed swap cannot be paused and ignores reduced-motion, so assistive readers catch whichever word is on screen. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: White bold heading text, "Build Amazing", sits on a near-black stage beside a dark rounded rectangle badge. The badge holds a lighter phrase such as "Landing Pages", hugging the word with even padding and sitting level with the heading.
behaves: On a fixed interval the badge swaps phrases: the current word slides down and blurs away while the next drops in from above, out of blur. The chip grows or shrinks to the new word's width, then holds still until the next swap.
customise: The leading label, the list of words and the interval are props; colours, border and type styles come from the source classes.
weight: light: One chip and a small timer; only the inner word animates briefly.
